headline: China's CCUS target sets 'credible benchmark' for oil and gas sector, says think tank
summary: Analysts and the Global CCS Institute characterise China's first quantified national CCUS objective — set out in the 15th Five-Year Plan for the oil and gas sector — as a constructive, credible policy benchmark, while cautioning that wider deployment will hinge on supporting policy, infrastructure and commercial frameworks.
co2crc_note: China setting its first quantified national CCUS target is a macro demand signal and a competitive/benchmarking reference point for Australia's own CCS ambitions in the Asia-Pacific.
extractor_note: Policy-signal item; no discrete figure cited in-window, so amount and capacity left null per no-fabrication rule.
